title: A build check's look takes the pages its time holds, at the rate the last look measured
steps: S1: run a whole look over two pages with a clock that moves 1 s a reading.
S2: fit five pages with no rate, with 100 s a page and two of them seen, and with 900 s a page.
expect: S1: the look says msPerPage, a positive number.
S2: every page; home, then the three unseen fitting 300 s with the two seen left; home alone.
evidence: Issue #247: six checks of a 29-page build each ran the full 300 s look and ended looked partly with 0 pages seen

tests: a look says what a page seen whole cost, and the next takes the pages its time holds (#247)
